population: complete natural standard-start Ironclad A20 Heart games in the privileged native surrogate

t_ref.formula: arithmetic mean of len(base.decisions) across all 1024 complete #82 TRAIN owners

s_ref.formula: population standard deviation (ddof=0) of R=100*heart_victory+terminal_floor across all 1024 complete #82 TRAIN owners

unchanged_actor_and_environment.actor: 2048-dimensional signed-hash semantic encoder and existing 128->64->1 action-conditioned actor

arms.A: legacy per-owner mean chosen logp; block mean/population-SD standardized reward advantage clipped to [-3,3]
arms.B: A with the realized trajectory decision-count divisor replaced only by fixed T_REF
arms.D: C with each reached-state reward residual R_i-V(h_t), using arm-local one-block-lagged V; block 1 V=0
arms.E: D plus detached arm-local one-block-lagged Q(h,a) correction over every ordered legal occurrence; Q labels are actual R from prior chosen actions only
arms.F: D plus coefficient 1.0 mean reached-state KL(pi_behavior||pi_current), behavior is the frozen block-generating actor

auxiliary_predictors.input_v: mean of source-qualified candidate feature rows across every ordered legal occurrence at the current reached state
auxiliary_predictors.input_q: source-qualified feature row for the actually chosen legal occurrence
auxiliary_predictors.output_initialization: zero final layer; V and Q initially predict zero
auxiliary_predictors.target: actual whole-game R=100*HeartWin+terminal_floor from that arm's completed prior training blocks
auxiliary_predictors.fit_schedule: before block k, one deterministic shuffled epoch (batch 256) over all completed blocks with index < k; freeze during block k

inference.primary: E_final-D_final mean paired terminal_floor on 320 TEST owners
inference.secondary_intervals: prespecified and unadjusted for multiple comparisons
inference.validation_use: diagnostic curves only; no selection, early stop, tuning, or promotion

limitations: one trained lineage per arm does not establish independent-training replicate stability or scaling
privileged native-surrogate training does not establish public-information or live-client efficacy
a CI spanning zero does not establish equivalence
